registry_info.name: lab
registry_info.description: Laboratory equipment artifacts for bench instruments, monitors, and advanced experimental devices
registry_info.theoretical_grounding: Embodied instrumentation and interface literacy in AdaResearch lab environments

spine_portal.name: Spine Corridor Portal
spine_portal.description: Step into this pillar of light to enter the spine-runner corridor mode. Loads vr_spine_runner.tscn via VRStaging's standard scene transition.

control_board.name: Control Board
control_board.description: Black Mesa-style mission control console with interactive CRT monitors, VU meters, push buttons, toggle switches, faders, rotary knobs, speaker and LED indicators. Screens flicker with phosphor glow, needles bounce to simulated signal, LEDs blink with activity.
interactions: move faders to drive VU meters
observe animated CRT screens and blinking indicators

pipettedispenser.name: Pipette Dispenser
pipettedispenser.description: Precision liquid handling instrument with volume feedback and dispense animation.

quantumentanglementmeter.name: Quantum Entanglement Meter
quantumentanglementmeter.description: Dual-chamber quantum diagnostic device with coherence and anomaly visualization.

resonancechamber.name: Resonance Chamber
resonancechamber.description: High-energy resonance chamber with rotating rings and phased conduit feedback.

fluxdetector.name: Flux Detector
fluxdetector.description: Temporal and field flux detector with sweep animations and anomaly signaling.

cryogenicpreservation.name: Cryogenic Preservation Unit
cryogenicpreservation.description: Cryogenic chamber with cooling cycle visuals and preservation state indicators.

robotarm.name: Robot Arm
robotarm.description: Articulated lab robot for scripted precision handling and calibration sequences.

circularradarmonitor.name: Circular Radar Monitor
circularradarmonitor.description: Circular sweep monitor with contact blips, range rings, and target status cues.

datatablet.name: Data Tablet
datatablet.description: Portable lab tablet interface for dataset refresh, sync status, and alerts.

electromagneticfieldgenerator.name: Electromagnetic Field Generator
electromagneticfieldgenerator.description: Electromagnetic generator with Tesla coil phases and field-strength dynamics.

terminal.name: Lab Terminal
terminal.description: Research terminal with animated status lights, screen flicker, and analysis cycle.

smallcontainment.name: smallcontainment
smallcontainment.description: Desk-scale containment cube with animated field projectors and floating specimen.

chair2.name: chair2
chair2.description: Procedurally builds a wood chair with seat, backrest, and legs atop a tartan accent pad.

lab_room.name: Lab Room
lab_room.description: Procedurally-generated Half-Life-style modern test chamber that frames a workbench. White tile floor, observation glass, accent-colored strip naming the QFEP phase, signage like 'TEST CHAMBER λ-S'. Takes a mounted_artifact_scene path and instantiates that workbench at the central plinth. The room IS the staging — same script, different DNA = different chamber.
interactions: observe the framed workbench at the central plinth

parameters.accent_color: QFEP phase color string 'r,g,b' (default lambda_edge red)
parameters.signage_top: Large signage line, e.g. 'TEST CHAMBER λ-S'
parameters.mounted_artifact_scene: Path to a workbench .tscn to instantiate at the central plinth

exit_sign.name: Exit Sign
exit_sign.description: Wall-mounted illuminated EXIT sign in Portal 2 / Half-Life vocabulary — emissive rectangle with white text and directional arrow. Default emerald green; tints by sign_color export for phase/warning variants.

parameters.mount_offset_z: Distance the sign protrudes from the wall (default 0.02)

sliding_door.name: Sliding Door
sliding_door.description: Two-panel pneumatic sliding door — Portal 2 / Half-Life airlock vocabulary. Dark metal frame, near-white panels with thin orange accent stripe at chest height. Static by default; panels_open_amount drives the slide from closed (0) to fully open (1).

parameters.accent_color: Stripe color (default Portal orange)

whiteboard.name: Whiteboard
whiteboard.description: Wall-mounted whiteboard — dark frame, near-white surface, optional pen tray. text_lines stacks Label3D rows on the surface so map_data can drop formulas, diagrams, or thinking onto walls. Curriculum-as-substrate.

parameters.text_lines: PackedStringArray of lines to render on the surface

large_table.name: Large Table
large_table.description: Rectangular lab counter / workbench at standard 0.95m work height. White laminate top with dark legs — either four corner posts (movable) or two continuous side panels (institutional). Optional thin emissive accent strip along the front edge.

parameters.leg_style: post (4 corner legs) | panel (continuous side panels)
parameters.edge_strip: Bool — emissive accent strip along front edge
parameters.accent_color: Edge-strip color when edge_strip is true

large_window.name: Large Window
large_window.description: Wall-mounted observation window — Portal 2 / Aperture vocabulary. Dark steel frame around a translucent grey-blue glass inset, with an optional thin Portal-orange emissive accent strip across the top of the frame. The membrane of mutual seeing between chamber and observer.

parameters.glass_color: Glass color with alpha (default translucent grey-blue)
parameters.glass_emission: Subtle inner glow on the glass (default 0.15)
parameters.accent_strip: Bool — thin emissive line at top of frame
parameters.accent_color: Accent strip color (default Portal orange)

info_screen.name: Info Screen
info_screen.description: Wall-mounted information display — Half-Life kiosk crossed with Aperture briefing screen. Dark plastic bezel around an emissive CRT-green screen face, configurable amber header and stacked terminal-green text lines. The chamber's structural form of LABELING.

parameters.screen_bg_color: Screen background color (default dark green-black CRT)

ceiling_vent.name: Ceiling Vent
ceiling_vent.description: Rectangular ceiling air vent — Aperture/Portal industrial vocabulary. Recessed cavity, dark steel frame, evenly-spaced light-gray slats. Optional subtle blue airflow glow behind the slats. Industrial cue: this is a built environment with HVAC running somewhere.

parameters.recess_depth: How deep the vent recesses into the ceiling (default 0.08)
parameters.airflow_glow: Bool — decorative airflow glow behind slats

cable_tray.name: Cable Tray
cable_tray.description: Ceiling-mounted cable tray — Aperture/Portal industrial vocabulary. Two dark steel side rails with evenly-spaced perpendicular rungs forming a ladder pattern, plus a small bundle of differently-colored cables running parallel along the length. The chamber as NODE in a wired facility.

parameters.cable_count: Number of cables in the tray (default 4)

lab_stool.name: Lab Stool
lab_stool.description: Adjustable swivel lab stool — Aperture / Black Mesa furniture vocabulary. Round soft-black seat on a vertical steel post, splayed five-pointed star base (office) OR continuous ring base (institutional), optional Portal-orange accent strip around the seat edge. base_style switches between movable and bolted-in postures.

parameters.base_style: five_star (5 radiating legs) | ring (continuous torus base)
parameters.accent_strip: Bool — emissive stripe around the seat edge
parameters.accent_color: Accent stripe color (default Portal orange)

fume_hood.name: Fume Hood
fume_hood.description: Glass-fronted chemistry fume hood — Black Mesa / Aperture chemistry vocabulary. U-shaped enclosure (three solid walls plus ceiling, open front), a translucent glass sash that slides upward by sash_open_amount, an interior worktop, an emissive ceiling light strip, dark-steel front frame, and a Portal-orange accent stripe along the bottom of the frame.

parameters.accent_color: Front accent stripe color (default Portal orange)
parameters.interior_light: Bool — emissive ceiling light inside the hood

server_rack.name: Server Rack
server_rack.description: 19-inch vertical compute rack — Aperture / Black Mesa infrastructure vocabulary. Dark-steel rectangular frame on four small feet, interior subdivided into rack_height_u U-slot markers, a configurable number of server faces with rows of emerald LEDs, a single Portal-orange accent stripe near the top, and a door that toggles solid (production) vs. open (exposed interior).

parameters.rack_height_u: Rack height in U units (default 24, range 8-42)
parameters.accent_color: Accent stripe color (default Portal orange)
parameters.door_open: Bool — false hides interior behind a solid panel, true exposes the LEDs

emergency_button.name: Emergency Button
emergency_button.description: Red mushroom E-stop on a yellow hazard plate — universal industrial-safety vocabulary. Yellow plate with a glowing alarm-red mushroom dome on a black ring base, a black Label3D below reading EMERGENCY STOP. pressed=true depresses the mushroom and dims the glow. mounting=podium adds a short pillar so the button stands free instead of mounting to a wall.

parameters.pressed: Bool — true depresses the mushroom and dims the glow

conveyor_belt.name: Conveyor Belt
conveyor_belt.description: Motorised conveyor belt — Portal 2 / industrial test-chamber vocabulary. Dark rubber deck on large end rollers and smaller underbelly rollers, vertical steel support legs, a Portal-orange accent strip along one long edge, and emissive triangular arrows along the deck pointing in the +X direction. Static-but-readable: the geometry SAYS the thing moves.

parameters.belt_length: Belt length along X in meters (default 2.4)
parameters.belt_width: Belt width along Z in meters (default 0.6)
parameters.direction_arrow_count: Number of emissive arrows painted on deck (default 5)
parameters.accent_color: Edge accent stripe color (default Portal orange)

safety_shower.name: Safety Shower
safety_shower.description: Emergency safety shower with eyewash basin — Half-Life decontamination-corner vocabulary. Vertical steel pipe (wall or ceiling), horizontal arm ending in a wide shower head, glossy white eyewash basin below with twin spouts and a valve handle, safety-green accent stripe around the basin, optional pull chain, and a SAFETY SHOWER Label3D above. The lab's confession that the experiment can wound.

parameters.shower_height: Top of shower head from floor (default 2.2)
parameters.pipe_color: Pipe and arm steel color (default dark steel)
parameters.accent_color: Accent stripe color (default safety green)
parameters.pipe_orientation: wall (rises from floor) | ceiling (descends from above)
parameters.signage_text: Label3D text above the shower (default 'SAFETY SHOWER')
parameters.chain_visible: Bool — render the pull chain below the shower arm

microscope.name: Microscope
microscope.description: Bench-top optical microscope — Half-Life lab vocabulary. Heavy dark steel base, a slightly tilted column, a glossy white stage with two specimen clamps, an objective turret carrying short lenses, one or two tilted eyepieces, and a small emissive bulb illuminator below the stage. The architectural form of LOOKING-CLOSER.

parameters.accent_color: Base accent strip color (default Portal orange)
parameters.light_on: Bool — illuminator emits warm light when true

specimen_jar.name: Specimen Jar
specimen_jar.description: Cylindrical glass containment on a rectangular plinth — Aperture / Black Mesa specimen-room vocabulary. Translucent jar with slight inner glow, a small dark cap, an interior content (blob, tendrils, crystal, or empty), an emissive accent stripe around the top of the plinth, and an amber Label3D on the front face. The architectural form of CURATED DISTANCE.

parameters.glass_color: Translucent glass color with alpha (default faint blue)
parameters.label_text: Amber Label3D text on plinth front (default 'SPECIMEN λ-S/Δ')
parameters.label_color: Label and accent strip color (default hazard amber)

fire_extinguisher.name: Fire Extinguisher
fire_extinguisher.description: Wall-mounted red fire extinguisher — Half-Life / industrial-corridor vocabulary. Alarm-red cylinder, narrow steel valve and pinch handle on top, coiled black hose curving down one side, steel wall bracket holding the cylinder against the wall, white accent band wrapping the middle, and a white 'FIRE' Label3D on the front. The architectural form of NAMED DANGER.

parameters.accent_color: Middle accent band color (default white)
parameters.hose_visible: Bool — coiled black hose hangs down one side when true (default true)
parameters.wall_bracket: Bool — steel wall bracket sits behind the cylinder when true (default true)

test_tube_rack.name: Test Tube Rack
test_tube_rack.description: Bench-top wooden test tube rack — chemistry-classroom vocabulary. Light wooden base with four corner posts and an upper holding plate, a single row of evenly-spaced glass test tubes, the first few tubes containing coloured liquid content, an emissive Portal-orange accent strip along the front of the base. The architectural form of REPEATED ATTEMPTS.

parameters.tube_count: Number of tubes in the row (default 6, range 3-12)
parameters.tube_content_count: How many tubes (from left) contain content (default 3)
parameters.tube_glass_color: Translucent glass color with alpha (default faint blue)
parameters.accent_color: Front accent strip color (default Portal orange)

gas_canister.name: Gas Canister
gas_canister.description: Pressurised gas cylinder on a steel cradle — industrial / hospital-supply vocabulary. Light teal body, tapered dark-steel shoulder cap, valve assembly (housing + red wheel handle + angled spout) on top, label naming the gas ('O₂') on the front, small emissive pressure indicator when pressurised, and a dark-steel cradle (vertical stand with ring, or horizontal arched supports). The architectural form of CONTAINED PRESSURE WAITING.

parameters.label_text: Front label text naming the gas (default 'O₂')
parameters.cradle_style: vertical | horizontal — stand-with-ring or arched-cradle (default vertical)
parameters.pressure_indicator: Bool — emissive dot showing pressurised state (default true)

palm_scanner.name: Palm Scanner
palm_scanner.description: Wall-mounted (or podium-mounted) biometric palm reader — Portal 2 / Aperture threshold vocabulary. Dark plastic rectangular panel with an inset scan window (emerald glow when active, dark when inactive), a faint raised palm-disc + 4 finger boxes hand outline, a status LED in the corner (green=active / red=inactive), a Portal-orange accent strip across the top, and a PLACE HAND Label3D below the scan window. Mounting toggles between flush wall placement and a 1m vertical podium stand.

parameters.scan_color: Active scan window / palm outline color (default emerald)
parameters.scan_active: Bool — when true the scan window glows and status LED is green
parameters.accent_color: Top accent strip color (default Portal orange)
parameters.label_text: Label3D text below the scan window (default 'PLACE HAND')
parameters.mounting: 'wall' = flush panel | 'podium' = panel on a 1m vertical stand

robot_arm.name: Robot Arm
robot_arm.description: Articulated lab arm on an industrial pedestal — Aperture / Boston-Dynamics vocabulary. Round steel base disc, a vertical yaw joint, a chain of 2-4 box-and-sphere segments stacked with per-joint X-axis pitch angles (arm bends in the XZ plane), and an optional two-jaw parallel gripper at the end. Each joint wears a Portal-orange accent stripe. Frozen in a programmed pose — a static glyph of motion.

parameters.arm_segment_count: Number of articulated arm segments (default 3, range 2-4)
parameters.segment_length: Length of each arm segment in meters (default 0.32)
parameters.body_color: Arm body steel color (default light steel)
parameters.joint_color: Joint and base color (default dark accent)
parameters.accent_color: Joint stripe color (default Portal orange)
parameters.gripper_visible: Bool — render the two-jaw parallel gripper at the end
parameters.pose_angles_degrees: PackedFloat32Array of joint angles bottom-up: [yaw, pitch_1, pitch_2, ...] — pads/truncates to segment_count+1 (default [0.0, -35.0, 70.0, -45.0])

glove_box.name: Glove Box
glove_box.description: Sealed handling chamber on four legs — Aperture / chemistry-lab vocabulary for 'this work cannot be touched directly'. Glossy white BoxMesh enclosure with a translucent glass top, an emissive interior ceiling plate, 1-3 black rubber glove ports on the front face (each port = dark CylinderMesh disc ringed by a TorusMesh cuff), a Portal-orange accent stripe across the front-top, and optional 4 vertical leg pillars.

parameters.glass_color: Top glass color with alpha (default faint translucent blue)
parameters.frame_color: Frame and leg color (default dark steel)
parameters.accent_color: Front-top accent stripe color (default Portal orange)
parameters.glove_color: Glove port disc color (default black rubber)
parameters.glove_count: Number of glove ports on front face (1-3, default 2)
parameters.glove_radius: Radius of each glove port in meters (default 0.07)
parameters.interior_light: Bool — emissive ceiling plate inside the chamber
parameters.legs_visible: Bool — render 4 vertical leg pillars under the body

autoclave.name: Autoclave
autoclave.description: Front-loading sterilizer drum on a rectangular cabinet — chemistry / biolab vocabulary. Glossy-steel cabinet with a round dark-steel door inset into the front face, a wheel-handle latch on the right of the door, a darker recessed interior cavity visible behind it when the door is open, a small status LED in the top-right corner, a Portal-orange accent stripe across the top, and an 'AUTOCLAVE' Label3D above the door. The architectural form of HEAT-AND-PRESSURE-AS-PURIFICATION.

parameters.door_radius: Round front door radius in meters (default 0.22)
parameters.door_open: Bool — when true the door swings 90° open around its left edge
parameters.interior_color: Recessed interior cavity color (default very dark steel)
parameters.accent_color: Top accent stripe color (default Portal orange)
parameters.status_indicator: Bool — render a small emissive LED in the top-right corner
parameters.status_color: LED color when running (default safety green)

chemistry_flask.name: Chemistry Flask
chemistry_flask.description: Bench-top chemistry flask — Erlenmeyer (wide cone + short neck), round-bottom (flattened sphere + thin neck), or volumetric (small bulb + long thin measurement neck). Translucent glass body, interior coloured content level filling content_height_fraction, optional dark stopper on top, small Label3D on the front naming the contents ('H₂SO₄'). The architectural form of A REAGENT WITH A NAME.

parameters.flask_max_radius: Widest point of the flask body in meters (default 0.06)
parameters.glass_color: Translucent glass color with alpha (default faint blue)
parameters.content_height_fraction: 0-1 fraction of flask_height filled with content (default 0.55)
parameters.content_color: Interior fluid color with alpha (default emerald translucent)
parameters.has_stopper: Bool — render a stopper on top of the neck (default true)
parameters.label_text: Front label text naming the contents (default 'H₂SO₄')

clamp_stand.name: Clamp Stand
clamp_stand.description: Bench retort stand with parametric clamps — chemistry-lab vocabulary. Heavy rectangular cast-iron base, thin vertical pole offset toward -X, 0-3 horizontal clamp arms at evenly-spaced heights with 2-prong grippers, optional small stylised Erlenmeyer flask held by the top clamp, and a Portal-orange accent stripe around the base. The architectural form of HANDS THAT DO NOT TIRE.

parameters.pole_height: Pole height above the base in meters (default 0.55)
parameters.clamp_count: Number of clamp arms on the pole (0-3, default 1)
parameters.accent_color: Base accent stripe color (default Portal orange)
parameters.holding_flask: Bool — render a small stylised flask in the top clamp's gripper (default false)

iv_stand.name: IV Stand
iv_stand.description: Wheeled medical IV pole with hanging bag — hospital / clinic vocabulary. Round dark-steel base disc with 4-6 small caster wheels around its perimeter, tall glossy-steel vertical pole rising from base center, L-shaped hook at the top, optional translucent IV bag hanging from the hook with amber fluid filling bag_full_fraction of the interior, 'IV' Label3D on the bag, and a Portal-orange accent ring around the base. The architectural form of MOBILE INFUSION.

parameters.pole_height: Top of pole from the floor in meters (default 1.6)
parameters.bag_color: IV bag translucent color (default faint translucent)
parameters.bag_visible: Bool — render the hanging bag (default true)
parameters.bag_full_fraction: 0-1 fraction of bag interior filled with fluid (default 0.75)
parameters.accent_color: Base accent ring color (default Portal orange)

lab_sink.name: Lab Sink
lab_sink.description: Rectangular lab counter with a recessed steel sink basin and a vertical faucet — Portal 2 / Half-Life utility-corner vocabulary. Glossy white counter top, polished steel basin sunk into it, faucet rising from the back (swan_neck = curved beak over the basin centerline, industrial = straight vertical pipe with perpendicular spout), twin valve handle discs at the base, an optional translucent water column when water_running=true, an optional twin-spout eyewash unit beside the faucet, and a Portal-orange accent stripe along the front edge. The lab's threshold between dirty-work and clean-work.

parameters.sink_width: Counter width along X in meters (default 0.60)
parameters.sink_depth: Counter depth along Z in meters (default 0.45)
parameters.basin_depth_factor: Basin well depth as a fraction of sink_height (default 0.20)
parameters.accent_color: Front-edge accent stripe color (default Portal orange)
parameters.water_color: Water column color with alpha (default faint translucent blue)
parameters.water_running: Bool — render a thin translucent water column from the spout into the basin
parameters.eyewash_present: Bool — add a small twin-spout eyewash unit beside the faucet

vacuum_chamber.name: Vacuum Chamber
vacuum_chamber.description: Translucent bell-jar on a dark steel platform — Aperture / alchemy vocabulary for 'this is the controlled void'. Round CylinderMesh platform, a faintly-translucent glass cylinder topped with a hemispherical dome (SphereMesh, half-height-scaled), an emissive interior disc giving the chamber its inside-light, a small pressure gauge on the front of the platform with a status-colored needle (green=vacuum, white=atmospheric, red=over), an optional floating sphere specimen in the chamber center, and a Portal-orange accent stripe ringing the platform's top edge.

parameters.jar_height: Glass body + dome combined height in meters (default 0.65)
parameters.glass_color: Glass color with alpha (default faint translucent blue-white)
parameters.specimen_color: Specimen color with alpha (default sickly green)
parameters.accent_color: Platform-top accent stripe color (default Portal orange)
parameters.gauge_present: Bool — render a pressure gauge on the platform front
parameters.pressure_status: vacuum (green needle) | atmospheric (white needle) | over (red needle)
parameters.specimen_visible: Bool — render a floating sphere specimen in the chamber center

electrical_panel.name: Electrical Panel
electrical_panel.description: Wall-mounted breaker box — Aperture / industrial-utility-corridor vocabulary. Flat rectangular panel hung on a wall, a hinged dark-steel door that covers it when closed or pivots 90° around its left edge when open to reveal a grid of breakers, each breaker a small black BoxMesh with a white lever toggle (UP=ON, DOWN=OFF), a row of small emissive status LEDs along the top of the panel, a hazard-yellow diagonal accent stripe across one corner, and a 'MAIN PANEL' Label3D below the lights. The lab's confession that POWER is also POLITICS.

parameters.panel_width: Panel width along X in meters (default 0.45)
parameters.panel_height: Panel height along Y in meters (default 0.65)
parameters.panel_depth: Panel depth from wall along Z in meters (default 0.08)
parameters.accent_color: Hazard accent stripe color (default hazard yellow)
parameters.door_open: Bool — when true the door pivots 90° around its left edge, revealing breakers
parameters.breakers_on_count: Number of breakers with levers in the ON position (default 8)
parameters.status_lights_count: Number of status LEDs along the panel top (default 3)
parameters.signage_text: Label3D text below the status lights (default 'MAIN PANEL')

floor_grate.name: Floor Grate
floor_grate.description: Walkable industrial metal grating — Portal 2 / Half-Life under-foot vocabulary. A perimeter steel frame around a regular lattice of crossing flat bars (bar_count_x running along +X, bar_count_z running along +Z), in dark steel. The bars sit BELOW the walking surface (origin = top walkable surface, Y=0). Optional Portal-orange safety stripe along the front edge, optional bar-by-bar brightness variation when wear_factor > 0. The lab admitting that the FLOOR itself is also infrastructure.

parameters.grate_width: Grate width along X in meters (default 1.0)
parameters.grate_depth: Grate depth along Z in meters (default 1.0)
parameters.grate_height: Total grate thickness below the walkable surface in meters (default 0.05)
parameters.bar_count_x: Number of bars running along the X axis (default 8)
parameters.bar_count_z: Number of cross-bars running along the Z axis (default 8)
parameters.frame_color: Perimeter frame color (default slightly darker steel)
parameters.accent_color: Front-edge accent stripe color (default Portal orange)
parameters.frame_visible: Bool — render the outer perimeter frame border (default true)
parameters.accent_visible: Bool — paint an accent stripe along the -Z front edge (default false)
parameters.wear_factor: 0-1 — alternate bar brightness for a worn look (default 0.0)

probability_box.name: Probability Box
probability_box.description: A small wooden dice tray with a low rim and 1-8 cube dice arranged across its surface — Aperture / casino-lab vocabulary. In the lab's grammar the probability_box IS the MONTE CARLO METHOD in object form: the tray is the sample space, the dice are the draws, the up-face values are the realised sample. Arrangements: scattered (random deterministic), row (linear trial), stacked (rigged column), cluster (corner cluster). Each die shows pip dots 1-6 on its top face. A Portal-orange emissive accent stripe rings the front rim.

parameters.tray_width: Tray width along X in meters (default 0.22)
parameters.tray_depth: Tray depth along Z in meters (default 0.16)
parameters.tray_rim_height: Rim height above tray base in meters (default 0.015)
parameters.dice_size: Edge length of each die in meters (default 0.018)
parameters.accent_color: Rim accent stripe color (default Portal orange)

map_table.name: Map Table
map_table.description: A heavy wooden tactical table with a parchment map laid flat on the tabletop — Aperture / war-room vocabulary. In the lab's grammar the map_table IS PATHFINDING (Dijkstra / A*) in object form: the grid is the graph, the dark obstacle boxes are closed nodes, the emissive Portal-blue path dots are the cost-minimising traversal, and the red start/end sphere markers are the source and sink. Tabletop on 4 corner legs, parchment surface, optional grid lines (grid_size cells along X), 0-15 deterministic obstacles, 11 path dots arcing diagonally corner-to-corner. Portal-orange emissive accent along the front edge.

parameters.table_width: Tabletop width along X in meters (default 1.40)
parameters.table_depth: Tabletop depth along Z in meters (default 0.90)
parameters.grid_visible: Bool — render the grid lines (default true)
parameters.grid_size: Number of grid cells along width 4-40 (default 12)
parameters.path_visible: Bool — render the emissive path dots (default true)
parameters.start_marker_visible: Bool — render start sphere at -X-Z corner (default true)
parameters.end_marker_visible: Bool — render end sphere at +X+Z corner (default true)
parameters.accent_color: Tabletop accent stripe color (default Portal orange)

pendulum.name: Pendulum
pendulum.description: An inverted-U metal stand with a string hanging from the center of the top bar, terminating in a polished brass bob — Aperture / lecture-hall vocabulary. In the lab's grammar the pendulum IS the HARMONIC OSCILLATOR in object form: length picks ω = √(g/L), angle picks the amplitude, and the bob holds the equation at a single frozen instant. The string is rotated by swing_angle_degrees around Z so the bob leans toward +X. Optional faint arc-dots trace the swept path between -angle and +angle. A Portal-orange emissive stripe rings the front of the top bar.

parameters.stand_width: Distance between the two vertical posts (default 0.32)
parameters.post_thickness: Post and bar thickness in meters (default 0.020)
parameters.swing_angle_degrees: Frozen swing angle from vertical in degrees (default 25.0)
parameters.arc_visible: Bool — render arc dots along the swept path (default false)
parameters.accent_color: Top-bar accent stripe color (default Portal orange)

prism.name: Prism
prism.description: A small triangular glass prism on a dark cylindrical pedestal with an incoming emissive white beam from -X and a rainbow fan of N emissive beams exiting toward +X — Aperture / spectroscope vocabulary. In the lab's grammar the prism IS SPECTRAL DECOMPOSITION (Fourier in glass) in object form: the white beam is the composite time-domain signal, the rainbow fan is the frequency-domain spectrum, and the dispersion of the glass IS the basis transform. Bands are hue-evenly-spaced red→violet (HSV) and fan vertically. Faint glass emission, Portal-orange emissive torus accent at the pedestal top.

parameters.prism_size: Edge length of the equilateral triangular face in meters (default 0.10)
parameters.prism_height: Length of the prism along its axis in meters (default 0.18)
parameters.glass_color: Glass color with alpha (default faint translucent blue-white)
parameters.pedestal_visible: Bool — render the pedestal under the prism (default true)
parameters.light_in_visible: Bool — render the incoming white beam from -X (default true)
parameters.light_out_visible: Bool — render the outgoing rainbow fan toward +X (default true)
parameters.accent_color: Pedestal accent ring color (default Portal orange)

oscilloscope.name: Oscilloscope
oscilloscope.description: Bench oscilloscope — rectangular dark-steel chassis with a recessed phosphor screen face, a dim emissive 8x6 graticule, an emissive dot trace sampled along the chosen waveform (sine, square, sawtooth, triangle, or composite-Fourier), a row of small control knobs along the screen's lower band, and a single status LED at the top-right corner. In the lab's grammar the oscilloscope is the FOURIER DECOMPOSITION TABLE — the place where a signal becomes its shape. The composite shape draws the truncated square-wave Fourier series (sin(f) + sin(3f)/3 + sin(5f)/5) so the trace IS the decomposition.

parameters.screen_width_factor: Screen width as fraction of body width 0.3-0.95 (default 0.70)
parameters.screen_height_factor: Screen height as fraction of body height 0.3-0.95 (default 0.65)
parameters.waveform_amplitude: Trace amplitude as fraction of screen height 0-1 (default 0.7)
parameters.accent_color: LED, knob indicator, and front-edge accent color (default Portal orange)

bunsen_burner.name: Bunsen Burner
bunsen_burner.description: Bunsen burner — heavy short dark-steel base, a narrow vertical tube, a small valve disc on the +X side (tick rotated by valve_position), an optional black gas hose entering from -X, and a two-stack tapered flame above the tube (wider lower body + brighter inner tip), both in flame_color with high emission. In the lab's grammar the bunsen burner is the SIMULATED-ANNEALING TEMPERATURE DIAL — the cooling schedule made visible. Cool blue + low + closed = ground state (T → 0); hot orange/yellow + tall + full = high-T exploration. Reading the flame reads the scheduler.

parameters.flame_color: Flame color encoding TEMPERATURE (default cool blue = low T)
parameters.body_color: Base and tube color (default dark steel)
parameters.gas_line_visible: Bool — render the gas hose entering from -X (default true)
parameters.accent_color: Valve tick and base accent ring color (default Portal orange)

petri_dish.name: Petri Dish
petri_dish.description: Shallow translucent petri dish — pale yellow-white agar disc, a thin translucent glass wall around the rim, an optional flat lid in faint glass, and a small grid of dark cell cubes on the agar surface in one of five canonical Conway's Life patterns (glider, blinker, block, random, empty), with an optional faint 8x8 graticule on the agar. In the lab's grammar the petri dish is the CONWAY'S GAME OF LIFE SUBSTRATE — a 2D world where local rules produce global behavior. Glider reads MOTION, blinker reads OSCILLATION, block reads STASIS, random reads SOUP, empty reads VOID.

parameters.glass_color: Translucent glass color with alpha (default faint blue-white)
parameters.cell_color: Cell cube color (default dark colony green)
parameters.grid_color: Faint surface graticule color (default warm grey)
parameters.accent_color: Base accent ring color (default Portal orange)
parameters.lid_present: Bool — render a translucent lid on top (default true)
parameters.grid_visible: Bool — render a faint 8x8 graticule on the agar surface (default false)

wall_clock.name: Wall Clock
wall_clock.description: Round wall clock — off-white face disc, dark steel torus frame ring, 12 radial tick marks, and three hands (hour + minute in dark, second hand in accent red) rotated by their respective hour/minute/second_hand_angle degrees CLOCKWISE from the 12 position; a small Portal-orange center cap covers the pivot. When is_digital=true the face is replaced by a large alarm-red digital readout Label3D. In the lab's grammar the wall clock is the SCHEDULER — the shared reference that lets concurrent processes synchronise.

parameters.hands_color: Hour and minute hand color (default near-black)
parameters.accent_color: Center cap color (default Portal orange)
parameters.digital_color: Digital readout color when is_digital=true (default alarm red)
parameters.hour_hand_angle: Hour hand rotation in degrees clockwise from 12 (default 270.0)
parameters.minute_hand_angle: Minute hand rotation in degrees clockwise from 12 (default 0.0)
parameters.second_hand_angle: Second hand rotation in degrees clockwise from 12 (default 30.0)
parameters.is_digital: Bool — replace analog hands with a digital Label3D readout (default false)

scales.name: Balance Scales
scales.description: A classical two-pan balance scale — polished brass base disc, short vertical column, horizontal beam crossing the top of the column tilted around the column's pivot by the load imbalance (left heavier tilts left-down), hanging 3-segment brass chains at each beam end, flat brass pans, and stacks of small dark-steel weight cubes sized to left_load and right_load. A small dark pointer arrow on the column reads the tilt against an implied zero. When tilt_from_loads=true the prop COMPUTES its own equilibrium from the load difference (a physical solver); otherwise tilt_degrees overrides directly. In the lab's grammar the scale is the ALGORITHM OF EQUILIBRIUM / ARGMIN — minimisation as object: beam = degree of freedom, loads = loss, equilibrium = argmin. Portal-orange torus accent ring at the base.

parameters.left_load: Visible weight units stacked on the LEFT pan (default 1.0)
parameters.right_load: Visible weight units stacked on the RIGHT pan (default 1.0)
parameters.tilt_degrees: Manual beam tilt in degrees (used only when tilt_from_loads=false; +30 = left heavier, -30 = right heavier; default 0.0)
parameters.tilt_from_loads: Bool — when true the beam tilt is computed from left_load - right_load; ignores tilt_degrees (default true)
parameters.pan_color: Pan color (default polished brass with slight emission)
parameters.accent_color: Base accent ring color (default Portal orange)

kaleidoscope.name: Kaleidoscope
kaleidoscope.description: A small kaleidoscope on a low stand — a horizontal cylindrical brass-and-steel tube whose axis runs along +X, a smaller dark eyepiece at +X, and a flat disc at -X divided into pattern_segments emissive pie-wedge shards that alternate between three accent colors so the eye reads mirror_count-fold dihedral symmetry (D3 at default = 3 mirrors). A Portal-orange emissive accent torus rings the tube at its midpoint. In the lab's grammar the kaleidoscope is the DIHEDRAL SYMMETRY GROUP / REFLECTION ALGORITHM in object form: the wedge is the fundamental domain, the mirror_count is the group order, and the disc is the orbit. Change mirror_count and you change the group the prop embodies.

parameters.eyepiece_visible: Bool — render the eyepiece at +X (default true)
parameters.mirror_count: Order of the dihedral symmetry group 2-8 — 3 = D3 standard kaleidoscope (default 3)
parameters.pattern_radius: Pattern disc radius at -X end in meters (default 0.05)
parameters.pattern_segments: Number of pattern wedges in the disc 2-24 (default 6)
parameters.accent_color: Tube accent ring color (default Portal orange)

abacus.name: Abacus
abacus.description: A classical abacus — light-wood rectangular frame in the XY plane facing +Z, with N vertical steel rods evenly spaced inside the frame, each rod threaded with M small spherical beads. Per rod a configurable count of beads have been pushed to the TOP (accent-color, slightly emissive); the remainder rest at the BOTTOM (dark wood). Each rod is a DIGIT, the up-beads are the DIGIT VALUE, and the row of digits across the rods is a POSITIONAL NUMBER. By default the up-counts encode π to 7 digits (3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9, 2). In the lab's grammar the abacus is the ALGORITHM OF POSITIONAL NUMERALS — place-value representation as object: rod = position, bead count = digit, rack = number. Portal-orange accent stripe across the bottom rail.

parameters.frame_width: Frame width along X in meters (default 0.35)
parameters.frame_height: Frame height along Y in meters (default 0.20)
parameters.frame_depth: Frame depth along Z in meters (default 0.025)
parameters.beads_per_rod: Number of beads on each rod 4-10 (default 5)
parameters.bead_color_low: Color of beads in the LOW position (default dark wood)
parameters.bead_color_high: Color of beads in the HIGH position (default accent red)
parameters.bead_positions: PackedInt32Array — number of beads pushed HIGH per rod, leftmost first (default [3,1,4,1,5,9,2] encoding pi)
parameters.accent_color: Bottom rail accent stripe color (default Portal orange)

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.description: A flat rectangular reflective glass pane in a dark wooden frame, optionally on a small base — a looking-glass standing in the lab. Multi-mirror arrangements compose: 'single' (one mirror, identity), 'parallel' (two mirrors facing each other 0.6m apart, infinite reflection cone), 'triangular' (three mirrors arranged as an equilateral triangle viewing inward, the kaleidoscope's parent geometry), or 'rect' (four mirrors arranged as a square, mutual reflection). Portal-orange accent stripe on the bottom of each frame. In the lab's grammar the mirror is the FIXED POINT / IDENTITY OPERATION — the algorithm whose answer is always 'the input again'. Composed with itself in parallel/triangular/rect arrangements, identity generates the dihedral group.

parameters.mirror_width: Mirror width along X in meters (default 0.45)
parameters.mirror_height: Mirror height along Y in meters (default 0.65)
parameters.mirror_depth: Mirror thickness along Z in meters (default 0.04)
parameters.glass_emission: Glass emission energy so the mirror reads 0-1 (default 0.15)
parameters.mount_stand: Bool — when true add a small stand under each mirror (default true)
parameters.accent_color: Bottom accent stripe color (default Portal orange)

terrarium.name: Terrarium
terrarium.description: A small rectangular glass terrarium tank — translucent walls in a thin dark-steel frame, a dark soil bed inside, scattered green plant prisms, white prey spheres ('rabbits'), and a larger reddish predator cube ('fox'), with a Portal-orange accent stripe along the top of the front face. In the lab's grammar the terrarium is the LOTKA-VOLTERRA PREDATOR-PREY SYSTEM — a closed dynamical system where prey graze on vegetation and predators eat prey, and the two populations oscillate in coupled cycles. The visible count of spheres and cubes IS the state vector x(t), y(t) at a frozen instant in time.

parameters.glass_color: Translucent glass color with alpha (default faint blue-white)
parameters.accent_color: Top-edge accent stripe color (default Portal orange)

fishbowl.name: Fishbowl
fishbowl.description: A small spherical glass fishbowl — translucent walls, a faint-blue water volume filling about three-quarters of the bowl, several small orange fish sphere particles scattered inside, rising white bubble spheres, and a fading chain of fish_trail_visible trail dots showing the random-walk path of ONE fish. A Portal-orange accent ring sits at the top rim. In the lab's grammar the fishbowl is the BROWNIAN MOTION / RANDOM WALK CHAMBER — a bounded fluid where particles take hash-deterministic small jumps, with one fish's trail rendered as a discrete sample of dW (the Wiener-process increments Robert Brown saw in pollen).

parameters.glass_color: Translucent glass color with alpha (default faint blue-white)
parameters.water_color: Faint-blue water color with alpha (default soft blue)
parameters.fish_trail_visible: Bool — render the random-walk trail of one fish (default true)
parameters.trail_color: Trail dot color with alpha (default fish-orange faded)
parameters.trail_dot_count: Number of dots in the random-walk trail 1-32 (default 8)
parameters.accent_color: Rim accent ring color (default Portal orange)

lock_box.name: Lock Box
lock_box.description: A small rectangular dark-steel strongbox with a slightly lighter pivoting lid hinged on its back edge by lid_open_amount × 90°, a row of brass combination dials across the front face (each with a red indicator notch rotated to a digit 0-9), an optional dark clasp on the lid front, a Label3D below the dials reading the combination as digits, and a Portal-orange accent stripe along the lid's leading edge. In the lab's grammar the lock_box is the HASH / COMMITMENT / ENCRYPTION OBJECT — a sealed container where dial_positions IS the key, the closed lid IS the commitment, and opening reveals a dark interior cavity (the decommitment). N dials at 10 positions each gives 10^N keys: 4 dials = 10000, the textbook combination-lock keyspace.

parameters.lid_open_amount: Lid open fraction 0-1 — 0 closed, 1 pivoted 90° open (default 0.0)
parameters.dial_indicator_color: Dial indicator notch color (default alarm red)
parameters.dial_positions: Per-dial position 0-9 as PackedInt32Array — pads/truncates to dial_count (default [3,7,1,5])
parameters.clasp_visible: Bool — render a dark clasp on the lid front (default true)
parameters.accent_color: Lid-edge accent stripe color (default Portal orange)

slide_projector.name: Slide Projector
slide_projector.description: A rectangular dark-steel projector chassis with a translucent lamp-warm glass lens recessed into the front (+Z) face, an emissive cone of light exiting the lens along +Z when beam_visible is true, a round dark-steel slide carousel disc on top with slide_count radial slot strips arranged in a ring, and a Portal-orange Label3D on the chassis face reading the current frame number (FRAME N). An accent stripe runs along the lens housing. In the lab's grammar the slide_projector is the SEQUENTIAL-FRAME / TIME-STEPPING / ANIMATION ENGINE — the discrete loop made physical: current_slide_number IS the loop variable i, slide_count IS the array length, the beam IS the redraw step.

parameters.lens_color: Translucent lens color with alpha (default warm glass)
parameters.lamp_on: Bool — lens glows with lamp emission when true (default true)
parameters.beam_visible: Bool — render an emissive light cone exiting the lens (default true)
parameters.current_slide_number: Integer shown on the FRAME N label (default 7)
parameters.slide_carousel_visible: Bool — render the circular slide tray on top (default true)
parameters.slide_count: Number of radial slot strips on the carousel 1-80 (default 40)
parameters.accent_color: Lens-housing accent stripe color (default Portal orange)

catalyst_pickup.name: catalyst_pickup
catalyst_pickup.description: Pedestal with a floating glowing orb. Grab it to complete a sequence — LabManager records completion and the bracelet's matching catalyst mode unlocks. The closing gesture that turns a lab chamber from museum to course.

parameters.sequence_name: string — the spine sequence this pickup represents (randomness, fractals, color, wavefunctions, cellularautomata, lsystems, swarmintelligence, transformation, forces)
parameters.orb_color: Color (r,g,b) — match the sequence's mode color
parameters.accent_color: Color (r,g,b) — accent ring color (matches sequence)
parameters.claimed: bool — when true, orb dims and ring turns green
parameters.pulsing: bool — gentle scale pulse on the orb
